landing_hero_title: Centralize your quotations and negotiate with suppliers in minutes
landing_hero_subtitle: Replace spreadsheets and manual tasks with a digital workflow featuring proposal comparison, full history, and faster purchasing decisions.
landing_problem_title: Traditional quotation workflows waste time and predictability
landing_problem_text: Phone calls, in-person visits, scattered messages, and disconnected spreadsheets make proposal comparison harder. The result is rework, delays, and lower decision transparency.
landing_solution_title: A faster, organized, and auditable procurement operation
landing_solution_text: With Bakery Quotation, your team creates quotes in a few clicks, invites suppliers at scale, and monitors everything from a single dashboard. The result: faster negotiations and higher confidence in every decision.
landing_benefits_title: Benefits that directly improve purchasing outcomes
landing_benefit_1_text: All suppliers and quotations in one place.
landing_benefit_2_text: Less operational time to create, track, and close quotations.
landing_benefit_3_text: Full visibility into dates, statuses, and proposal evolution.
landing_benefit_4_text: Compare prices and conditions with clear per-product view.
landing_benefit_5_text: Review past decisions and previous negotiations quickly.
landing_step_1: Register products and suppliers in a few minutes.
landing_step_2: Create the quotation and define start/end windows.
landing_step_3: Suppliers submit bids online in real time.
landing_step_4: Compare proposals and close with more confidence.
landing_social_title: Ready to scale with your procurement operation
landing_social_text: A section ready for customer logos, testimonials, and case studies as your go-to-market evolves.
landing_final_title: Bring your procurement team to a high-performance SaaS standard
landing_final_text: Reduce operational effort and increase control over each quotation through a professional, digital, and centralized workflow.
